description: Repairs r-sort-3b/create-nulls: every INSERT into NI8 and NU1..NU4 was Database.Execute with no options, so refused rows returned hr 0 and the error numbers were never captured. Fixture (General ACCDB, dbVersion120). The five tables (ID Long primary key, K TEXT(20), N Long), each with its index built first (NI8 non-unique WITH DISALLOW NULL on (K, N); NU1 unique (K, N) IGNORE NULL; NU2 unique (K, N) DISALLOW NULL; NU3 unique (K, N); NU4 unique (K DESC) IGNORE NULL), then 18 single-row INSERTs over K in (Null, empty, a) x N in (Null, 1, 2) twice, each with dbFailOnError and DBEngine.Errors read after it. Reads the surviving IDs, the refreshed index metadata and the forward walk of IX of each table.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
